imagery.label: Design-Inspirationen, mit KI gestaltet.
imagery.services: Shared desktop preview in normal flow; mobile opens the selected inline photograph. No-JavaScript fallback is three desktop columns and two mobile columns.
imagery.inspiration: Three-column aligned collection with a dominant first image spanning two rows; equal two-column mobile collection.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; min-height:52px; padding:12px 25px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); font-family:var(--body, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.7; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #8a613b); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } }.ds-btn-primary { background:var(--gold, #8a613b); color:var(--white, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); color:var(--white, #ffffff); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:25px; font-family:var(--body, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { position:relative; padding:12px 0; color:var(--ink, #2d211b); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.7; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-nav a::after { position:absolute; content:''; height:1px; background:var(--gold, #8a613b); bottom:7px; left:0; right:0; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #8a613b); outline-offset:5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav a::after { transition:none; } }

components.name: Service Selection

components.css: .ds-service { padding:17px 0 19px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #e0cfbe); } .ds-service h3 { margin:0; font-weight:500; } .ds-service-select { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #2d211b); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; font-family:var(--display, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); font-size:clamp(28px, 2.8vw, 36px); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.08; transition:color .2s; } .ds-service-select svg { flex-shrink:0; transform:rotate(-45deg); opacity:.45; } .ds-service-select[aria-pressed='true'] { color:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); } .ds-service-select[aria-pressed='true'] svg { transform:rotate(0); opacity:1; } .ds-service-select:hover { color:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); } .ds-service-select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #8a613b); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-service p { margin:9px 0 0; max-width:48ch; color:var(--muted, #514137); font-family:var(--body, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-service-select { transition:none; } } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-service-select { font-size:29px; gap:12px; } }

components.css: .ds-price { color:var(--ink, #2d211b); font-family:var(--body, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); background:var(--cream, #f5ebe2); padding:28px 32px; } .ds-price summary { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; } .ds-price summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-price summary>span:first-child { flex:1; font-family:var(--display, 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif); font-size:35px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.15; } .ds-price summary:hover { color:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); } .ds-price summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #8a613b); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-price-from { color:var(--muted, #514137); font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-disclosure { position:relative; width:16px; height:16px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-disclosure::before,.ds-disclosure::after { content:''; position:absolute; background:var(--gold, #8a613b); width:14px; height:1px; top:7px; left:1px; } .ds-disclosure::after { transform:rotate(90deg); transition:transform .2s; } .ds-price[open] .ds-disclosure::after { transform:rotate(0); } .ds-price-rows { margin-top:22px; border-top:1px solid var(--line, #e0cfbe); padding-top:14px; } .ds-price-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:24px; padding:7px 0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; } .ds-price-row>span { color:var(--muted, #514137); } .ds-price-row strong { flex-shrink:0; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-disclosure::after { transition:none; } }

components.css: .ds-video-play { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; min-height:150px; border:0; background:rgb(64 48 38 / 12%); cursor:pointer; } .ds-play-icon { display:grid; place-items:center; width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--white, #ffffff); color:var(--gold-deep, #6c472b); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgb(64 48 38 / 15%); transition:transform .2s; } .ds-play-icon svg { margin-left:4px; } .ds-video-play:hover .ds-play-icon { transform:scale(1.08); } .ds-video-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #8a613b); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-play-icon { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Emily Nails pairs warm ivory surfaces with bronze-gold actions and soft blush accents taken from the original logo. The original logo and local social icons anchor the identity. Restrained serif headings, shared alignments and readable service information preserve the elegant, gentle character.

This is a native static HTML, CSS and JavaScript system with one light theme. Typography, tonal section changes and thin dividers carry the visual hierarchy. Keep the original logo and German business truth: services, prices, contact information, opening hours, social links and legal attribution remain faithful to the salon.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory surfaces, bronze-gold accents and gentle blush details.
Self-hosted serif display type paired with a clear sans serif body.
Clear content grouping, aligned rectangular media and consistent vertical rhythm.
Thin dividers, subtly rounded controls and native progressive disclosure.
Purposeful cover and selection motion with a complete reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Use gold to make actions and selected content clear; retain pale surfaces as the dominant material.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for editorial titles and the sans serif for functional information, controls and numbers. Preserve tabular numerals for prices, telephone numbers and opening hours.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary content flat; reserve elevation for interactive overlays and the video play affordance.

dos: Do retain the elegant, gentle logo-derived palette and the original Emily Nails logo.
Do use serif hierarchy, readable sans copy and tabular practical information.
Do preserve shared alignment, responsive stacking, thin dividers and consistent space around grouped content.
Do retain every published German business fact and keep booking actions connected to the existing phone and SMS links.
Do preserve native disclosure, dialog fallbacks, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't present decorative campaign imagery as completed salon work.
Don't invent reviews, ratings, services, prices or an online booking workflow.
Don't add a dark theme or replace the approved ivory, gold and blush direction with another identity.
Don't put ordinary services and prices into heavily rounded, shadowed cards.
Don't autoplay video or make content visibility depend on animation or JavaScript.
